categories.main_business_segments: Amentum operates through two primary business segments: Digital Solutions (DS) and Global Engineering Solutions (GES). The DS segment delivers advanced digital and data-driven solutions, including intelligence analytics, space system development, cybersecurity, and next-generation IT for federal and commercial clients. The GES segment focuses on large-scale environmental remediation, nuclear power solutions, platform engineering, sustainment, and supply chain management for the U.S. government and allied nations worldwide.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Amentum leverages advanced engineering, digital modernization, cybersecurity, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and lifecycle IT services. The company employs proprietary methodologies in environmental remediation, nuclear technology development (including AMRs and SMRs), intelligence analytics, C5ISR, and RDT&E. Solutions are delivered through a combination of in-house expertise, joint ventures, and partnerships, utilizing both traditional engineering and cutting-edge digital tools.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are U.S. federal government agencies (notably the Department of Energy, Department of War, Intelligence Community, NASA, and DHS), which accounted for 81% of 2025 revenues. Other key markets include allied governments (U.K. MOD, U.K. NDA, Australian DOD), select international governments, and commercial sectors such as aerospace, space, automotive, and telecommunications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Amentum has a global footprint, with operations in over 70 countries and significant employee presence internationally (25% of workforce). Major regions include the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Europe, and the Indo-Pacific, with additional operations across all seven continents. Key support locations are in the U.S., U.K., Poland, UAE, and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Amentum primarily operates as a prime contractor, providing end-to-end solutions across the full mission lifecycle for government and commercial clients. The company is positioned downstream in the supply chain, integrating technologies, managing complex programs, and delivering turnkey services, while also engaging in joint ventures and subcontracting roles as needed.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include winning and executing large, complex government programs, expanding digital modernization and cyber capabilities, penetrating high-growth markets (cybersecurity, hypersonics, autonomy, space-based defense, nuclear power), and leveraging RDT&E for innovation. The company emphasizes agility, technology transfer between government and commercial domains, and disciplined capital allocation to drive growth and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Amentum generates revenue primarily through long-term government and commercial contracts, utilizing cost-plus-fee (63% of 2025 revenues), fixed-price (24%), and time-and-materials (13%) structures. Revenue is recognized over time as services are delivered, with a significant portion supported by a large backlog ($47.1 billion as of October 2025).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include Booz Allen Hamilton, CACI, KBR, Leidos, ManTech, Parsons, Peraton, SAIC, V2X, and large defense contractors such as Boeing, BAE Systems, General Dynamics, L3Harris, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, and RTX. In the U.K., competitors include Babcock, Mott MacDonald, Serco, and Mace; in environmental services, AtkinsRealis, Bechtel, BWX Technologies, Honeywell, Huntington Ingalls, Fluor, and Westinghouse. Amentum is positioned as a leading, diversified, large-scale solutions provider with broad technical capabilities and global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2025, Amentum reported revenues of $14.4 billion, a 72% increase year-over-year due to the merger with CMS. The company has approximately 50,000 employees and maintains a substantial backlog of $47.1 billion, providing strong revenue visibility. Adjusted EBITDA for 2025 was $1.1 billion, reflecting significant scale and growth momentum post-merger.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Amentum differentiates itself through its scale, breadth of technical expertise, and ability to deliver full lifecycle, mission-critical solutions for complex government and commercial challenges. The company emphasizes its trusted partner status, deep customer knowledge, advanced digital and engineering capabilities, and proven track record in high-priority domains such as energy transformation, environmental remediation, intelligence, and space. Its agile, innovation-driven culture and global reach further enhance its competitive advantage.
